title: Dianna Russini took vicious shot at JJ McCarthy during police interaction: ‘Your quarterback sucks’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dianna Russini took vicious shot at JJ McCarthy during police interaction: ‘Your quarterback sucks’
sources.description: The quarterback caught a stray from former NFL insider Dianna Russini when she was pulled over by police in January for texting and driving, as seen in video footage of the incident making rounds online.
